terms.gloss: a hindrance, an obstacle; in the plural, baggage, the baggage of an army
evidence: Liv. 9.19.5: impedīmentum magis quam auxilium (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BG 1.24: impedīmenta in ūnum locum contulērunt (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: Dēmosthenēs impedīmenta nātūrae dīligentiā industriāque superāvit
phrases.english: Demosthenes overcame the hindrances of nature by care and hard work
they brought the baggage together in one place
